rows.text: Greeting: Well, well, still in one piece, youngster. I was going to offer you a drink from the previous Amber Era, but you don't quite look the part. Ha, ha, ha.
rows.speaker: Mehjesty

rows.text: I'd like to chat with you awhile longer.
Of course, of course... I'd be more than happy to impart the value of time to others.
rows.speaker: Mehjesty

rows.text: Why do you hold such high regard for antiquity?
Logic: Age is a mark of seniority, which means handling the unexpected with greater ease. This is what we call "with age comes mastery."
rows.speaker: Mehjesty

rows.text: More importantly, the pursuit of time's passage is a biological instinct.
rows.speaker: Mehjesty

rows.text: Much like how you humans are drawn to such fermented foods as aged wine, fine cheese, and a perfectly matured steak, the passage of time does tend to bring out richer flavors. Spoiling and going moldy, of course, being the obvious exception.
rows.speaker: Mehjesty

rows.text: And finally, I can proudly claim that I hold the philosophy of respecting the elders. But if you tell me you have a preference for the younger ones — I mean, in the strictly biological sense...
rows.speaker: Mehjesty

rows.text: I'm going to zap you with electricity immediately, a volt attack unique to Intellitrons!
rows.speaker: Mehjesty

rows.text: Mind if I ask what you do for a living?

Clarification: Currently on a retirement trip. But fifteen years ago, I was an archaeologist with the Intelligentsia Guild's Astral Ecology School. I still hold an advisory position today, responsible for passing down the "Half-Life" authentication method.
rows.speaker: Mehjesty

rows.text: Ever since Ether authentication came along, however, this technique has all but faded into obscurity. I might be the only one in the entire Guild still keeping it alive. They even gave me a little nickname for it: "Immemorially Unique One." ...To be honest, I'm rather fond of it.
rows.speaker: Mehjesty

rows.text: As for why I didn't just join the Armed Archaeologists... I simply don't agree with how that bunch throws ancient protocols to the wind. Besides, my classic-model exoskeleton isn't exactly built for high-intensity excavation work.
rows.speaker: Mehjesty

rows.text: Alright. Here's to a long and full life.
rows.speaker: Mehjesty

rows.text: I've got things to do. Take care!
Alright. Here's to a long and full life.
rows.speaker: Mehjesty
